title: DICOM for Medical Application Developers
strapline: From the End Exam button to the wire: associations, tags, worklists, gateways, and the evidence that images land where they belong.
author: Anthony Narine
promise: By the end, you should be able to look at any imaging integration and answer five questions: Who is calling whom? What is being sent, and in what form? How does each image find its patient and exam? Who is allowed to send, and how do we know? What evidence proves an image landed where it belongs?
